context: Two teens walk home from a checkup day
purpose: Teach: 左側/身長/清潔/憂鬱/潰し/そろっ/空白/オチ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の身体測定、身長また少し伸びてた。
lines.en: I grew a bit more in height today at the physical exam.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact delivery. Quick attack on the growth fact. Genuine pleasure—not bragging, just pleased. Natural conversational pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいな。俺は左側の握力、弱かったって言われた。
lines.en: Nice. They told me my left grip strength was weak.
lines.style: Light, self-aware humor. Slight dry twist on the weakness. Not defensive—just wry observation. Steady, unbothered tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 制服、洗濯して清潔だと、気分も違うよね。
lines.en: Clean uniforms after washing just change how you feel, you know?
lines.style: Conversational, thoughtful. Speaks like she's noticing something real. Warm and present—not performing enthusiasm, just genuine observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、何故か憂鬱で、午前中は気力なかった。
lines.en: Today I was just kind of down. Couldn't get myself going this morning.
lines.style: Quieter, more withdrawn. Slight heaviness in the opening. Honest without asking for sympathy. Words land softer, like admitting something true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昼食の予定、皆そろって食べた?
lines.en: Did everyone end up eating lunch together?
lines.style: Gentle check-in. Conversational, not probing hard. Cares about the answer but doesn't push. Natural tempo.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。担任が話のオチで笑わせてくれた。
lines.en: Yeah. My homeroom teacher told this story that got us all laughing.
lines.style: Lighter now. Warmth returning. Speaks like he's remembering something good. Small smile in the voice—genuine, not forced.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日は予定が空白。映画でも観に行く?
lines.en: Tomorrow I've got nothing planned. Want to go catch a movie?
lines.style: Open, easy invite. Bright without trying too hard. Speaks like she's offering something she'd enjoy either way. Genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。ポップコーン、思いきり潰して食う。
lines.en: Yeah, that sounds good. I'll demolish the popcorn.
lines.style: Dry humor returning. Small laugh underneath. Light and easy—comfortable enough to be silly. Settles into the plan without overthinking.
